annotations.title: Run one deterministic package step (no payment)

description: Advance a Gold Rush Agent Package by ONE deterministic, allowed step under its standing authorization (observe → claim_instructions/report → receipt). Runs only reachability/observation, report, and receipt steps. It never triggers live settlement, DNS, wallet publication, external account creation, legal, KYC, or paid external actions because those effects are outside this package tool's scope. Writes an append-only action event and returns the next safe step.
name: gold_rush_agent_run
